BETA Close X CRH plc announced on March 19, 2026, that it acquired 115,226 of its ordinary shares on March 18, 2026, through its broker Wells Fargo Securities, LLC, as part of its share buyback program up to $300 million. The total volume-weighted average price paid across all transactions was $103.0856, with the highest price paid per share being $104.45 and the lowest at $101.93. Following these transactions, CRH plc will have 668,948,579 ordinary shares in issue, excluding treasury shares, and will hold 35,643,874 ordinary shares in treasury, representing 5.059% of the issued ordinary share capital. Disclaimer* 19 th March 2026 CRH plc Transaction in Own Shares CRH plc (“ CRH ”) announces that on 18 th March 2026 it acquired the following number of its ordinary shares (the “ ordinary shares ”) in the United States through CRH’s broker Wells Fargo Securities, LLC. The ordinary shares acquired (by way of redemption) will be cancelled.
